course_name_original: Introducción A La Programación Para La Red
prerequisites: Approved the course "Fundamentos de Informática" (Fundamentals of Computer Science).

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and abilities to apply the scientific and technological fundamentals of network programming.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Internet and web services
Creation of web pages in HTML
Configuration and management of a web server
teaching_methods: Learning monitoring through the Virtual Course
assessment_rules: The final grade is composed of a 90% in-person exam and a 10% obligatory practical exercise. Both the exam and the practical exercise must be passed separately. A minimum grade of 5 on the exam is required to have the practical exercise score added. Failure to pass the practical exercise results in a final course grade of 0, and the exam score is not saved. The practical exercise grade is valid for the June and September calls but not for subsequent academic years.
